reason: The plugin primarily orchestrates independent one-shot and continuing subagent conversations through /btw and /side, with isolated context, tool activity, and a persistent side panel.

summaries.zh: 通过 /btw 和 /side 创建与管理独立的侧会话，让用户在不中断主会话的情况下进行一次性提问或持续对话。
summaries.en: Creates and manages independent side conversations with /btw and /side so users can ask one-off questions or continue a separate dialogue without interrupting the main session.

capabilities: forks independent subagent sessions from the current conversation
runs one-shot and persistent side conversations
may invoke configured tools within side sessions
persists and displays side-session messages and execution logs
forwards image attachments to side sessions
